title: 106th Rescue Wing February Team Rescue TV
description: The 106th Rescue Wing produces its monthly news broadcast Team Rescue TV at Francis S. Gabreski Air National Guard Base, Westhampton Beach, N.Y., February 3, 2024. Team Rescue TV is the 106th's monthly news broadcast that informs the Wing on events and training conducted throughout each month. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Captain Cheran Campbell, Technical Sgt. Daniel Farrell, Technical Sgt. Sean Madden, Technical Sgt. Kevin Donaldson, and Senior Airman Sarah McKernan)
keywords: 106th Rescue Wing, NYNG, Air National Guard
credit: Capt. Cheran Campbell, Tech. Sgt. Kevin Donaldson, Tech. Sgt. Daniel Farrell, Tech. Sgt. Sean Madden, Senior Airman Sarah McKernan

The 3001st rescue Squadron hosted their
annual competition where 7 Air Force
rescue helicopter squadrons competed in
combat search and rescue skills events
at Avon Park Air Force Range , Florida .
Over the course of a week , the events
in which CISAR squadrons competed
included weapons employment using
helicopter mounted machine guns , air
to air refueling with HC-130 aircraft ,
navigation , search , and confined
hoisting . The top squadron award , a
combination of the best team with the
fastest times , the best pilot overall
score , and the best special missions
aviator score , went to the 11th
rescue squadron . Congratulations .
